color.note: Dark only: the sources define no light theme, so none is invented. Values are exactly as written in static/brand.css, static/dashboard.html and daily_planet_report.html; names follow brand.css minus its color- prefix.

tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page background on every Integra surface: logotype, reports, dashboards. Brand.css: --color-void; dashboards: --void.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Fill of cards, chart panels and gauge cards, always on `void`. Dashboards: --card-bg.

tokens.name: panel-inset
tokens.usage: Inset tiles inside a `card`: metric boxes and lens boxes.

tokens.name: panel-inset-strong
tokens.usage: Clock cards inside a `card`.

tokens.name: monolith
tokens.usage: Primary text and the logotype on `void` and `card` (16:1 and 15.9:1). Deliberately off-white: never use pure white for Integra text.

tokens.name: monolith-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text, meta lines, axis and gauge labels on `void` and `card` (8.3:1 and 7.8:1). Dashboards: --monolith-dim.

tokens.name: monolith-faint
tokens.usage: Lens-box descriptions only. 3.4:1 on `card`: below 4.5:1 for the 0.45rem text the source sets in it, kept exact.

tokens.name: card-border
tokens.usage: The 1px edge of cards and the rule under report headers and footers. Decorative divider, about 1.1:1 on `void`: never the only cue that marks a control.

tokens.name: border-soft
tokens.usage: Edge of metric boxes and the rule under a section label, inside a `card`.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edge of clock cards.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Row separator in the standard data table. Report page.

tokens.name: hairline-compact
tokens.usage: Row separator in the compact data table. Dashboard.

tokens.name: row-alt
tokens.usage: Zebra row fill in the standard data table. Report page: --table-row-alt.

tokens.name: row-alt-compact
tokens.usage: Zebra row fill in the compact data table. Dashboard.

tokens.name: flame-core
tokens.usage: Solar gold. Metric values, prices, ticker readouts and the second stop of the brand gradients; also the standby state. 10.4:1 on `card`.

tokens.name: flame-primary
tokens.usage: Primary orange. Third stop of the brand gradients, the antithesis emphasis in prose and the text fallback behind gradient text.

tokens.name: flame-deep
tokens.usage: Ember terminus of the brand gradients and the alert state. Alert text uses it with `flame-glow`. 6.2:1 on `card`.

tokens.name: sentinel-cyan
tokens.usage: Heimdall cyan: section titles, table headers, meta labels, the OK state and the first stop of the brand gradients. 14:1 on `card`. Dashboards: --cyan.

tokens.name: sentinel-ice
tokens.usage: Ice-blue variant of the sentinel cyan. Declared in brand.css, with no consumer in the sources.

tokens.name: sentinel-mint
tokens.usage: Second stop of the five-stop footer tagline gradient only; it is also the left half of the tagline in the logo image.

tokens.name: cyan-dim
tokens.usage: Declared in the dashboards' :root, with no consumer in the sources.

tokens.name: cyan-rule
tokens.usage: Rule under a section title.

tokens.name: table-head
tokens.usage: Header band of the standard data table. Report page: --table-header-bg.

tokens.name: table-head-compact
tokens.usage: Header band of the compact data table. Dashboard.

tokens.name: table-rule-compact
tokens.usage: Rule under the compact data table header.

tokens.name: purple-neon
tokens.usage: Sovereign purple: structure (card labels, section numbers, the version badge, card edges) and the sovereign status. 3.65:1 on `card` and 3.9:1 on `void`: passes 3:1 for large text and marks, fails 4.5:1 for the 0.55-0.65rem labels the source sets in it. Kept exact; see Audit notes.

tokens.name: purple-amethyst
tokens.usage: Epiphany amethyst. Lens counts and section labels. 4.57:1 on `void`, 4.30:1 on `card`.

tokens.name: purple-royal
tokens.usage: Royal purple accent. Declared in brand.css, with no consumer in the sources. 3.3:1 on `card`: not for text.

tokens.name: purple-dim
tokens.usage: Edge of lens boxes.

tokens.name: purple-faint
tokens.usage: Footer telemetry line on the report page. 1.6:1 on `void`: decorative only.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Live, up, active and approved: the live dot, kernel pill, up moves, active lobes. 7.8:1 on `card`.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Down moves and offline lobes. 5.3:1 on `card`. Pair with a word or arrow: it is told from `green` by hue alone.

tokens.name: green-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the ON protocol badge.

tokens.name: green-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of the ON protocol badge.

tokens.name: green-wash
tokens.usage: Fill of the kernel pill.

tokens.name: green-ring
tokens.usage: Edge of the kernel pill.

tokens.name: red-wash
tokens.usage: Fill of the kernel pill in its INACTIVE state.

tokens.name: red-ring
tokens.usage: Edge of the kernel pill in its INACTIVE state.

tokens.name: cyan-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the READY protocol badge.

tokens.name: cyan-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of the READY protocol badge.

tokens.name: gold-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the ACTIVE protocol badge.

tokens.name: gold-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of the ACTIVE protocol badge.

tokens.name: slate-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the STANDBY protocol badge.

tokens.name: slate-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of the STANDBY protocol badge.

tokens.name: celestial-indigo
tokens.usage: Card label and caption text on the celestial-kinematics card, on `card`. 6.6:1.

tokens.name: celestial-indigo-soft
tokens.usage: Highlighted values inside the celestial-kinematics card. 13:1 on `card`.

tokens.name: celestial-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of the celestial-kinematics card, replacing `card-border`.

tokens.name: clock-lilac
tokens.usage: Digital clock time on `panel-inset-strong`. 10:1.

tokens.name: clock-periwinkle
tokens.usage: Celestial rotation readout on `card`. 8.6:1.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The Integra wordmark in `monolith`. The source scales it with the viewport (clamp 3rem to 7rem on the logo page, 7vw in brand.css, 12vw under 768px); 7rem is the ceiling.

styles.name: tagline
styles.usage: Uppercase tagline under the wordmark, filled with the subtitle gradient. Scales from 0.7rem; 1.2rem is the ceiling.

styles.name: wordmark-footer
styles.usage: The wordmark in a report or dashboard footer, in `monolith`.

styles.name: tagline-footer
styles.usage: Tagline under the footer wordmark, filled with the five-stop footer gradient.

styles.name: report-brand
styles.usage: Gradient brand line above a report title. Dashboards set it at 0.9rem.

styles.name: report-brand-compact
styles.usage: Gradient brand line in a dashboard header.

styles.name: report-title
styles.usage: Title of a report page, in `monolith`.

styles.name: report-title-compact
styles.usage: Title in a dashboard header, in `monolith`.

styles.name: report-title-solid
styles.usage: Brand.css's report header: `monolith` over a 2px `purple-neon` rule.

styles.name: section-number
styles.usage: Uppercase section counter in `purple-neon` above a section title.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Uppercase section title in `sentinel-cyan` over a `cyan-rule`.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Uppercase divider label in `purple-amethyst` between dashboard rows.

styles.name: card-label
styles.usage: Uppercase label at the top of a report card, in `purple-neon`.

styles.name: card-label-compact
styles.usage: Uppercase label at the top of a dashboard card, in the card's own accent color.

styles.name: table-head
styles.usage: Uppercase column header in `sentinel-cyan`, standard table.

styles.name: table-head-compact
styles.usage: Uppercase column header in `sentinel-cyan`, compact table.

styles.name: gauge-value
styles.usage: Large number on a gauge card, colored by its meaning: `flame-core`, `green`, `sentinel-cyan`.

styles.name: metric-label
styles.usage: Uppercase caption under a metric value, in `monolith-dim`. 7px: the source's smallest text.

styles.name: lens-name
styles.usage: Uppercase caption in a lens box, in `monolith-dim`.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Protocol status badge text.

styles.name: kernel-pill
styles.usage: Text of the kernel connection pill.

styles.name: telemetry
styles.usage: Telemetry readout under the logotype: `sentinel-cyan` labels with `flame-core` values.

styles.name: telemetry-footer
styles.usage: Telemetry line in a footer.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Volatility has compressed sub-15 on the VIX.
styles.usage: Body text on a report page, in `monolith-dim`; strong words in `monolith`. Prose paragraphs open the line height to 1.7.

styles.name: body-compact
styles.usage: Body text on a dashboard.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Header meta line on a report page: `sentinel-cyan` labels, `monolith-dim` values.

styles.name: meta-compact
styles.usage: Header meta line on a dashboard.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footer and secondary captions in `monolith-dim`.

styles.name: table-cell
styles.usage: Cell text in the standard data table.

styles.name: table-cell-compact
styles.usage: Cell text in the compact data table.

styles.name: metric-value
styles.usage: Value in a metric box, in `flame-core` unless its meaning sets another color.

styles.name: metric-value-sm
styles.usage: Value in a small metric box and a lens count.

styles.name: clock-time
styles.usage: Digital clock time in `clock-lilac` with `clock-glow`.

styles.name: celestial-readout
styles.usage: Celestial rotation readout in `clock-periwinkle` with `celestial-glow`. The dashboard sets it at 1.8rem inside the kinematics card.

spacing.note: Derived, not original: the sources use rem lengths directly. These steps are the values that recur across the dashboards, reports and logotype.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tightest grid gap (6-column lens grid).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap of the 4-column metric grid; bottom margin of a card label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of a compact card; dashboard header bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard grid gap; padding between cards; dashboard card side padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of a standard report card, chart panel and gauge card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dashboard side padding; report header bottom padding; gap between meta items.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Report page padding; logotype padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between report sections.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Protocol badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Lens boxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Metric boxes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Report cards, gauge cards, chart panels and clock cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dashboard cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The kernel connection pill.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: The live dot and the glow ring.

shadow.note: Glows light text and status marks only. The sources never put a drop shadow or glow on a card.

tokens.name: flame-glow
tokens.usage: Text-shadow for alert text in `flame-deep`.

tokens.name: purple-glow
tokens.usage: Text-shadow for sovereign status text in `purple-neon`.

tokens.name: cyan-glow
tokens.usage: Text-shadow for OK status text in `sentinel-cyan`.

tokens.name: green-glow
tokens.usage: Glow of the live dot.

tokens.name: green-glow-lg
tokens.usage: Glow of the dot inside the kernel pill.

tokens.name: red-glow
tokens.usage: Glow of the live dot and the kernel-pill dot in their INACTIVE state.

tokens.name: clock-glow
tokens.usage: Text-shadow of the digital clock time.

tokens.name: celestial-glow
tokens.usage: Text-shadow of the celestial rotation readout.

tokens.name: title-glow
tokens.usage: Resting text-shadow of the logotype wordmark; the live logo pulses it between 0.12 and 0.25.
